purpose: Bound direct callers of the segment-3 VGA/BOB entry used while investigating the special WOLKE renderer.

methods: bounded opcode scan for direct 16-bit near CALL targets across segments 1-6

relocation_census.interpretation: The only relocation-backed call to the generic VGA/BOB entry is the normal render-queue call from 01F7:35B3.

raw_near_call_scan.interpretation: No additional direct near-call encoding targets offset 0x0013 in the six file-backed segments. This is a bounded byte-level scan, not a proof against an indirect function-pointer call.

conclusion: The ordinary queue caller is statically unique among direct relocation-backed and direct near-call forms. A WOLKE-specific draw, if present, must use an indirect/constructed call path, a different primitive, or a runtime path not represented as a direct call to 01F7:0013.
